appraisal_events.evidence: "Je sentais sa maîtrise dans un mode de désignations où j'avais peur qu'elle ne constatât et ne méprisât mon infériorité"; the passage closes with "je pensais alors qu'il n'existait pas de personne plus désirable."
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine's assured, insider command of 'petite bande' slang (tram, tacot) intimidates the narrator, who fears she perceives his own inferiority, yet this very mastery is what makes her, in his eyes, supremely desirable by the passage's end.

status_effects.explanation: Her fluent, unselfconscious use of casual local idiom marks her as locally masterful and confident, elevating her rhetorical standing over the narrator.
The narrator feels intimidated and fears exposure of his own inferiority in the face of Albertine's easy command of the group's idiom.
